items.title: What happens to frameworks in the agents era
items.text: What happens to frameworks in the agents era? to component libraries? to @shadcn? The answer is: we need to drill deeper. Delete the part, optimize, accelerate, automate. UI SDK is like the x86 instruction set for agents to build new UI components spontaneously. Agents are the new design engineers, and they're ready to build *anything* you ask, tailored to your usecase. High-level, rigid, single-framework abstractions are like kryptonite for what is essentially an infinite, untiring creation machine.
